parameters.text: =You are a markets analyst. Given these metrics for {{ $json.symbol }}: - Period return: {{ $json.period_return_pct }}% - Annualised volatility: {{ $json.annualised_volatility_pct }}% - Price vs 50-day SMA: {{ $json.price_vs_sma50_pct }}% - Price vs 200-day SMA: {{ $json.price_vs_sma200_pct }}% - Golden cross (50-day above 200-day): {{ $json.golden_cross }} - Max drawdown: {{ $json.max_drawdown_pct }}% Write a one-paragraph view (max 4 sentences) on whether the trend looks bullish, bearish, or neutral, and a conviction score from 1-10. Base your view ONLY on these numbers — do not invent any other data. Respond in this exact JSON shape: {"symbol": "...", "view": "...", "conviction": 0}

parameters.jsCode: const raw = $input.item.json.output; let parsed; try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { const match = raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); parsed = match ? JSON.parse(match[0]) : { view: raw, conviction: 5 }; } const metrics = $('Metics in JavaScript').item.json; return { json: { symbol: metrics.symbol, period_return_pct: metrics.period_return_pct, annualised_volatility_pct: metrics.annualised_volatility_pct, price_vs_sma50_pct: metrics.price_vs_sma50_pct, price_vs_sma200_pct: metrics.price_vs_sma200_pct, golden_cross: metrics.golden_cross, max_drawdown_pct: metrics.max_drawdown_pct, analyst_view: parsed.view, conviction: parsed.conviction } };

parameters.text: =You are a risk manager. Account size: $10,000. Max risk per trade: 1% of account ($100). Ticker: {{ $json.symbol }} Analyst view: {{ $json.analyst_view }} Conviction (1-10): {{ $json.conviction }} Annualised volatility: {{ $json.annualised_volatility_pct }}% Max drawdown: {{ $json.max_drawdown_pct }}% Using annualised volatility as a proxy for stop distance (assume stop = 2x daily volatility, where daily volatility = annualised volatility ÷ √252), calculate: 1. Stop distance in percent 2. Position size in dollars such that a stop-out loses no more than the max risk per trade 3. A rejection flag: true if conviction < 4 OR annualised volatility > 50%, else false Respond ONLY in this JSON shape: {"symbol": "...", "position_size_usd": 0, "stop_distance_pct": 0, "rejected": false, "reason": "..."}
